core_decision: Stop treating Jarvis as planning-only or wallpaper-only. Preserve the Commander requirements and build the real Kingsmen Jarvis system.
rules: Jarvis must be live, visual, clickable, listening, speaking, intelligent, organized, professional, respectful, disciplined, and connected to Kingsmen.
The locked visual reference is the system identity, not decoration.
Do not change the locked visual direction without Commander instruction.
Do not give PowerShell syntax as CMD syntax.
Local runtime proof is required before claiming Jarvis works locally.
GitHub proof is required before claiming local Builder Core work is preserved.
Public Jarvis or OpenClaw tools are research-only until vetted.
OpenClaw is guarded operator support, not the brain.
Playwright is probe and scout only.
No chat claim replaces repo proof.
next_build_focus: convert Jarvis HUD into a unified live system shell
add Commander real-build status into runtime
prove with build and smoke evidence
